core_concepts: MESSAGE FROM THE AUTHOR + DEDICATION I’m immensely grateful that this book is in your hands

The 5 Club is based on a concept and method that I’ve been teaching to celebrated entrepreneurs, CEOs of legendary companies, sports superstars, music icons and members of royalty—with extraordinary success—for over t
I wrote this book over a four-year period, in Italy, South Africa, Canada, Switzerland, Russia, Brazil and Mauritius
I’ve given all I have to give in the writing of this book for you
And so, with a full heart, I humbly dedicate this work to you, the reader
My deep hope is that it serves the full expression of your gifts and talents beautifully
And causes revolutions of heroic transformation within your creativity, productivity, prosperity and service to the world
Sometimes the words flowed effortlessly as if a gentle summer breeze was at my back and at other times, I struggled to move ahead
